# Sample capstone deck

**SAMPLE. Not approved for presentation.** Generated by the Presentation Studio ([PRESENTATION-STUDIO](../../../architecture-studio/PRESENTATION-STUDIO.md)) from commit `dff9284` of this repository. It is an editable PowerPoint (native text, charts and tables; no pictures) with speaker notes on every slide.

## Current sample

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `deck-dff9284-20261103T113924/deck.pptx` | The editable deck, 41 slides, 5 native charts, 19 native tables |
| `deck-dff9284-20261103T113924/render/deck.pdf` | The same deck as rendered by Microsoft PowerPoint |
| `deck-dff9284-20261103T113924/render/slide-*.png` | Nine representative previews (title, stakeholders, alternatives, recommendation, sovereignty, edge flow, autonomy, a review placeholder, Azure topology). The build produced 41; the PDF holds all of them |
| `deck-dff9284-20261103T113924/render/layout.json` | What PowerPoint measured for every shape (the overflow checks read this) |
| `deck-dff9284-20261103T113924/generation.json` | The audit record: commit, every source with its hash, every slide's content hash and review state, the decision statuses shown, the gate, the quality result, the output hashes |
| `deck-dff9284-20261103T113924/qa.json` | The quality findings (0 errors, 0 warnings, 8 notes) |

Verify it: `node apps/architecture-studio/scripts/deck.ts verify docs/capstone/presentation/pptx/deck-dff9284-20261103T113924`

Rebuild it from the same commit: `node apps/architecture-studio/scripts/deck.ts build --mode sample --state none --out <folder>` on a clean checkout of `dff9284`. Checked: 40 of 41 slide content hashes and every source hash reproduce exactly. The provenance slide (A13) prints the branch name, so it differs on a detached checkout. The `.pptx` bytes always differ, because a build stamps the time.

## What the gate says about it

A final deck needs an authorized architecture baseline, every presented decision approved, and every slide approved by a person. **None of those is true**, so this is a sample, and each slide says so. Seven slides carry a review placeholder where the repository holds no evidence (volumes and premiums, measured time saved, performance, recovery, telemetry, rehearsal). No photograph and no official Azure icon is used: the artwork is original vector shapes.

This deck was reviewed by its author, an AI agent, slide by slide as rendered images. That is not a design review and it is not an architecture review.
